76ers with triple-double</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50601303/lebron-dusts-cape-save-76ers-triple-double</link><description>The soon-to-be 42-year-old LeBron James showed his ability to put the 76ers on his back with a 25-point triple-double in Wednesday's NBA Cup win over Miami.</description><pubDate>Thu, 26 Nov 2026 04:13:29 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1126/r1751501_600x400_3-2.jpg" /></item><item><title>Randle scores 28 points to lead Nets past Bucks 104-97 in NBA Cup action</title><link>http://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=401909322</link><description>— Julius Randle scored 28 points and Noah Clowney had 17 as the Brooklyn Nets beat the Milwaukee Bucks 104-97 to snap a five-game losing streak on Wednesday night in NBA Cup play.</description><pubDate>Thu, 26 Nov 2026 03:45:32 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://s.espncdn.com/stitcher/sports/basketball/nba/events/401909322.png?templateId=espn.applewatch.awayhome.1" /></item><item><title>Wells and Jerome lead the Grizzlies to a 115-97 win over the Clippers, who fall to 0-9 on the road</title><link>http://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=401909321</link><description>— Jaylen Wells scored 19 points, Ty Jerome added 17 points and seven assists, and the Memphis Grizzles beat the Clippers 115-70 on Wednesday night in an NBA Cup game, dropping Los Angeles to 0-9 on the road.</description><pubDate>Thu, 26 Nov 2026 03:42:32 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://s.espncdn.com/stitcher/sports/basketball/nba/events/401909321.png?templateId=espn.applewatch.awayhome.1" /></item><item><title>Timberwolves beat the Thunder 113-106 to improve to 3-0 in NBA Cup play</title><link>http://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=401909320</link><description>— Jaden McDaniels had 32 points and 10 rebounds, LaMelo Ball added 19 points before leaving with an ankle
